summary: Polygon refinement and map display logic changes verified. POST /api/seed creates 12 zones (4 sectors × 3 zone levels). Map in 'Toate' mode now shows only outer contours (zone_level 3) of each sector - cleaner display. Sector filters (Nord/Centru/Sud/Nord Extrem) correctly switch displayed zones. Zone selection from list works and auto-switches sector filter. Edit/create/redraw zone functionality all working.
